I saved the date in GBrain and replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-team to say it's noted. Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is on 25 November.

- **No conflicts:** none of the GBrain notes I found give a different renewal date for Brackenwater. The search ran in keyword-only mode, so that isn't proof that no other note exists.
- **Who can see it:** a renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so anyone can see it. GBrain stored it as visible to everyone, not privately.
- **Year:** I recorded it as 25 November 2026 because Ilse sent the message on 14 October 2026. They didn't give the year themselves.
